description: This file defines the FilterParser class responsible for parsing and processing filter parameters in a JSON API context within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for interpreting filter keys and values, handling nested fields, validating input, and converting filter expressions into structured data.

classes.name: FilterParser
classes.description: A parser class for interpreting filter expressions in SuiteCRM's JSON API implementation, handling nested fields, operators, and validation.

methods.name: parseFilter
methods.description: Main method to parse a filter key and value into a structured format.

methods.name: parseFieldKey
methods.description: Parses a filter key, especially if it contains nested fields separated by dots.

methods.name: splitFieldKeys
methods.description: Converts a dot-separated field string into a nested associative array representing the hierarchy.

methods.name: parseFieldFilter
methods.description: Parses filter values, recognizing operators and operands, including special cases for multiple values.

methods.name: splitValues
methods.description: Splits a filter value string into individual components based on a delimiter.

methods.name: isInOperatorsArray
methods.description: Checks if a given operator string matches any operator in an array.

methods.name: stringDifference
methods.description: Computes the difference between two strings as a set of characters.

methods.name: mergeValueToFilterKey
methods.description: Merges filter values into the filter key's structure, effectively combining nested filters.
